metadata.question: Are there more than three lakes within a 50 km radius of coordinates (35.879797, 86.428836) in Augest 11, 2024?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Primary: Sentinel-2 SR (COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED) filtered to 2024-08-11 ± 0 days within a 50 km buffer around (35.879797, 86.428836). - Fallback 1: Widen Sentinel-2 window to ±7 days. - Fallback 2: Landsat 8/9 SR (LC08/LC09 C02 L2) within ±14 days. 2. Masking strategy: - Sentinel-2: QA60 cloud/cirrus mask; reflectance scaled to [0,1]. - Landsat: QA_PIXEL cloud/shadow/dilated cloud mask; apply scale factors. - Water detection: mNDWI > 0.2 AND NDVI < 0.1 to suppress non-water. 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null/Error: - If collections empty after all fallbacks: C1. - If valid pixels after masking = 0: C2. - If computed lakes count is null/invalid: C3. - Otherwise compare lakes count (> 3 => A; else B). ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { try { // Helpers const eeGet = (obj) => new Promise((resolve, reject) => obj.evaluate(resolve, reject)); const pt = ee.Geometry.Point([86.428836, 35.879797]); const region = pt.buffer(50000); // 50 km radius const primaryStart = '2024-08-11'; const primaryEnd = '2024-08-12'; const s2ExpandStart = '2024-08-04'; const s2ExpandEnd = '2024-08-18'; const lsExpandStart = '2024-07-28'; const lsExpandEnd = '2024-08-25'; const minLakeArea_m2 = 20000; // 0.02 km2 const ccScale = 100; // reproject water mask to 100 m for connected components const reduceScale = 1000; // reduceRegion scale per best practice // Masking and index functions function maskS2(img) { const qa = img.select('QA60'); const cloudBitMask = 1 << 10; const cirrusBitMask = 1 << 11; const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(cloudBitMask).eq(0).and(qa.bitwiseAnd(cirrusBitMask).eq(0)); return img.updateMask(mask).divide(10000) .copyProperties(img, ['CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 'SENSING_TIME']); } function addS2Indices(img) { const mndwi = img.select('B3').subtract(img.select('B11')).divide(img.select('B3').add(img.select('B11'))).rename('mndwi'); const ndvi = img.select('B8').subtract(img.select('B4')).divide(img.select('B8').add(img.select('B4'))).rename('ndvi'); return img.addBands([mndwi, ndvi]); } function scaleAndMaskLandsat(img) { // Apply scale factors const scaled = img.select(['SR_B2','SR_B3','SR_B4','SR_B5','SR_B6','SR_B7']) .multiply(0.0000275).add(-0.2) .rename(['B2','B3','B4','B5','B6','B7']); const qa = img.select('QA_PIXEL'); const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 3).eq(0) // Cloud .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 4).eq(0)) // Cloud shadow .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 1).eq(0)); // Dilated cloud return scaled.updateMask(mask).copyProperties(img, ['CLOUD_COVER', 'DATE_ACQUIRED']); } function addLsIndices(img) { const mndwi = img.select('B3').subtract(img.select('B6')).divide(img.select('B3').add(img.select('B6'))).rename('mndwi'); const ndvi = img.select('B5').subtract(img.select('B4')).divide(img.select('B5').add(img.select('B4'))).rename('ndvi'); return img.addBands([mndwi, ndvi]); } // 1) Collections let s2Primary = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(region).filterDate(primaryStart, primaryEnd); let s2PrimarySize = await eeGet(s2Primary.size()); console.log(`Primary S2 imgs: ${s2PrimarySize}`); let chosenImg = null; let source = null; let cloudProp = null; if (s2PrimarySize > 0) { const s2Sel = s2Primary.map(maskS2).map(addS2Indices).sort('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE').first().clip(region); chosenImg = s2Sel; source = 'S2'; cloudProp = await eeGet(s2Sel.get('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE')); } else { const s2Expanded = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(region).filterDate(s2ExpandStart, s2ExpandEnd); const s2ExpandedSize = await eeGet(s2Expanded.size()); console.log(`Expanded S2 imgs: ${s2ExpandedSize}`); if (s2ExpandedSize > 0) { const s2Sel = s2Expanded.map(maskS2).map(addS2Indices).sort('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE').first().clip(region); chosenImg = s2Sel; source = 'S2'; cloudProp = await eeGet(s2Sel.get('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE')); } else { const l8 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2').filterBounds(region).filterDate(lsExpandStart, lsExpandEnd); const l9 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC09/C02/T1_L2').filterBounds(region).filterDate(lsExpandStart, lsExpandEnd); const ls = l8.merge(l9); const lsSize = await eeGet(ls.size()); console.log(`Landsat imgs: ${lsSize}`); if (lsSize === 0) { console.log('No images found in all windows.'); console.log('C1'); return; } const lsSel = ls.sort('CLOUD_COVER').map(scaleAndMaskLandsat).map(addLsIndices).first().clip(region); chosenImg = lsSel; source = 'Landsat'; cloudProp = await eeGet(lsSel.get('CLOUD_COVER')); } } // 2) Valid pixel count after masking (use a band that exists for both) const baseBand = source === 'S2' ? 'B3' : 'B3'; const validPixDict = await eeGet(chosenImg.select(baseBand).reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: region, scale: reduceScale, maxPixels: 1e9 })); const validPix = validPixDict ? (validPixDict[baseBand] || 0) : 0; const cloudStr = cloudProp !== null && cloudProp !== undefined ? Number(cloudProp).toFixed(1) : 'NA'; console.log(`Using: ${source}, Cloud%: ${cloudStr}, Valid px: ${validPix}`); if (!validPix || validPix === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels after masking.'); console.log('C2'); return; } // 3) Water mask and lakes counting const water = chosenImg.select('mndwi').gt(0.2).and(chosenImg.select('ndvi').lt(0.1)); // Reproject to coarse resolution for efficient connected components const waterRep = water.reproject({crs: chosenImg.projection(), scale: ccScale}); const minPix = ee.Number(minLakeArea_m2).divide(ee.Number(ccScale).pow(2)).ceil(); const bigWater = waterRep.updateMask(waterRep).connectedPixelCount(1e7, true).gte(minPix).selfMask(); // Count connected components (lakes) const labels = bigWater.connectedComponents(ee.Kernel.square(1), 1e7); const labelCountDict = await eeGet(labels.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.countDistinct(), geometry: region, scale: reduceScale, maxPixels: 1e9 })); const lakeCount = labelCountDict ? labelCountDict.labels : null; console.log(`Lakes (>0.02 km2): ${lakeCount}`); // 4) Validation & Final Answer if (lakeCount === null || lakeCount === undefined || isNaN(lakeCount)) { console.log('C3'); return; } if (Number(lakeCount) > 3) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } catch (err) { console.log(`Error: ${err}`); console.log('D'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
